activation: Native parallel CLI argv[23]=1 or run_native_cohort.py --summary-hbm; requires worker-shadow-sync>0
scope: Same synthesizable endpoint called live by native search; CPU C-model on real graph and actual XRT CU on bounded fixture. CPU retains full net sets, search frontier and atomic net commit.
topology: Every full-membership native boundary, including unused/inaccessible route nodes; immutable sorted unique node:u32|mask:u32 words. Owner is lowest membership bit.
execution: A distinct ring per actor/CU and one mutex per CU. Owner installation happens before a search window and before each validation, after all proposals join. Searches only read owner arrays and modify their own per-lane receiver slots. Refresh scans subscribed keys on CPU, comparing endpoint fetch and inspect values. No host worker-value cache.
publication: Upload all boundary slots on new session; then changed tuples only with expected previous version. Host publication bookkeeper never supplies a consumed search value. Complete final cache drain and owner/cache inventories required.
validation: Every actual remote consumed tuple goes through owner_validate. Compare status-derived stale indices with CPU reference, abort on disagreement, replay stale proposal after forced refresh. Full net-set/footprint validation and atomic commit remain CPU.
queue: Capacity 8, one request per invocation, monotonic per actor/die tickets, response completion before next call. Bounded synchronous orchestration; batching/async scheduling unimplemented.

summary_hbm_frames.bin.payload: Five 64-byte words: command packet, descriptor, response packet, receipt, completion
summary_hbm_frames.bin.actor: 0..net_workers-1 per lane; net_workers is publication controller
summary_hbm_frames.bin.publication_attempt: 0 at window start/final; 2*(slot+1)+attempt before candidate validation
summary_hbm_frames.bin.final: iteration UINT32_MAX, wave global completed window count
summary_hbm_frames.bin.normalization: repeat=0 and command/response/completion session=1; all other words byte-identical across repeats

artifacts.summary_hbm_owners.csv: Actual output array/readback: repeat,owner,node,occupancy,history,version for every directory node
artifacts.summary_hbm_caches.csv: Actual output array/readback: repeat,lane,worker,node,occupancy,history,version for current-session initialized receiver records

trace_order: Within immutable proposal phase, drain lane traces in ascending lane order before commit. This is a deterministic linearization of commuting lane operations, not physical interleaving or timing.
independent_audit: Python replays all commands/receipts/completions, queue tickets, owner/receiver values, final tables, observed queries and validation outcomes. Installs are bound to separately reconstructed CPU authority at exact window/validation phase. Full native transaction audit separately replays footprint, conflict, branch cost and atomic commit.
limits: No complete router or full-net hardware transaction
No asynchronous host-device memory coherence or autonomous inter-CU network
Small XRT adapter supports <=16 slots, <=4 lanes, <=3 CUs; real graph C-model only
No physical platform placement/timing, board throughput/energy or new QoR proof
Single-command launches and CPU scans are functional integration; no performance claim
